map.如果被埋压：保持冷静，保存体力；用石块敲击管线或墙壁发出求救信号；不要大声呼喊以: If buried: stay calm and conserve strength; tap pipes or walls with a stone to send a distress signal; don't shout loudly to avoid inhaling dust; clear dust near mouth and nose to keep breathing unobstructed.

map.以「高层公寓」为例生成建议: Example: generate advice for a 'high-rise apartment'
map.避险优先选择承重墙墙角、小开间（卫生间、厨房）等易形成三角空间的位置，远离外墙、: For shelter, prioritize corners of load-bearing walls and small rooms (bathroom, kitchen) that easily form triangular spaces, staying away from exterior walls, glass windows and chandeliers; during the main shock never take the elevator, shelter in place, and after the shaking weakens evacuate orderly by stairs to open ground; immediately after the quake check gas valves and circuits, and only use them after confirming safety. Detached houses or villas should keep away from tall furniture and walls; school classrooms follow instructions to quickly evacuate along the planned route to the playground.
map.高层住户地震时要不要跑下楼？: Should high-floor residents run downstairs during an earthquake?
map.强烈震动时先就地避险（伏地、遮挡、抓牢），不要盲目跑动——楼梯拥挤、坠物与眩晕都: During strong shaking, first shelter in place (drop, cover, hold on) and don't run blindly - crowded stairs, falling objects and dizziness all increase danger; evacuate orderly after the main shock passes. In daily life, familiarize yourself with the nearest safe stairs and outdoor meeting point.
map.逃生路线规划要考虑哪些要素？: What elements should escape-route planning consider?
map.至少准备两条相互独立的安全出口，避开玻璃幕墙、高大货架与外墙；集合点选在远离建筑: Prepare at least two independent safe exits, avoiding glass curtain walls, tall shelves and exterior walls; choose a meeting point in open ground away from buildings; also anticipate night and power-outage scenarios, and place flashlights and emergency kits at the door and bedside to ensure they are always accessible.
